key.name: gitlab-url
key.description: The URL of your GitLab server (e.g., https://gitlab.com)

key.name: gitlab-token
key.description: Personal access token for GitLab API authentication

key.name: report-tags-filter
key.description: Comma-separated list of tags or regex patterns to filter in reports (e.g., "Maintenance corrective,^Maintenance.*$"). Leave empty to show all tags.

key.name: timer-state
key.description: JSON string containing the current timer state (for persistence across lock screen)

key.name: recent-issues
key.description: JSON list containing the last issues that received tracked time

key.name: selection-state
key.description: JSON object used by the external selector window to send the selected project and issue back to the extension

key.name: default-project
key.description: JSON object containing the default project used by the issue selector

key.name: projects-cache
key.description: JSON object containing the cached GitLab project list

key.name: resume-on-unlock
key.summary: Resume timer when screen is unlocked
key.description: When enabled, the timer will automatically resume when the screen is unlocked

key.name: count-time-when-locked
key.description: When enabled (and resume-on-unlock is enabled), the elapsed time during lock/logout/shutdown will be counted

key.name: toggle-timer-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to start, pause, resume, or select an issue for the timer

key.name: stop-send-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to stop the timer and send tracked time to GitLab

key.name: cancel-timer-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to cancel the current timer without sending time

key.name: select-issue-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open the project and issue selector

key.name: monthly-report-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to open the monthly report dialog

key.name: issue-filter-search
key.description: Search text used when loading issues from GitLab

key.name: issue-filter-state
key.description: Issue state used when loading issues from GitLab

key.name: issue-filter-assignee
key.description: Assignee username, me, or None used when loading issues from GitLab

key.name: issue-filter-labels
key.description: Comma-separated labels used when loading issues from GitLab
